messages:
ryan-partners: HelioBridge just kicked off a co-sell pilot ask. They want a short POC playbook, a committed pricing sketch for 500k tokens/week (6-week pilot), and answers on KMS + data residency. Can we assemble items by tomorrow?

tara-se: I can build the demo flow. proposal: spin up a dedicated tenant in us-east-1, show end-to-end request, then flip to hosted fallback. keep live prompt simple (search+summarize).

mohit-ops: OK. I'll prepare the tenant + network steps and a small runbook. need to confirm whether HelioBridge needs static egress IPs for their firewall. anyone have a precedent?

diana-security: They flagged HIPAA and EU residency as potential blockers. We need to call out what we can do: Dedicated in-region, customer-managed KMS, and retention controls. I'll draft answers for the questionnaire.

elaine-sales: Pricing context: HelioBridge expects committed discount vs on-demand. For 500k tokens/week (~2M tokens/mo) over 6 weeks, they want a short PO and clear early-termination rules. Can we propose a pilot rate and a conversion path to a quarterly commit?

tara-se: For the demo, I recommend a quantized 7B-compatible variant to hit p95 latency < 250ms on the staging GPUs. we'll capture perf numbers live.

mohit-ops: Runbook snippet (will flesh out in doc):

```
# create demo tenant
redwood tenant create --name heliobridge-pilot --region us-east-1 --capacity dedicated --duration 6w

# allowlist our demo gateway IPs
redwood network allowlist add --tenant heliobridge-pilot --cidr 54.23.12.34/32

# fallback to hosted
redwood routing set --tenant heliobridge-pilot --route hosted-default
```

elaine-sales: Draft pilot quote (internal): 2M tokens/month committed @ $0.30 / 1k tokens => ~$600/mo for pilot months. Overage billed at $0.50 / 1k. Pilot PO for 6 weeks pro-rated. Mark this as provisional until finance OKs.

diana-security: KMS answer draft: we support customer-managed keys via AWS KMS and HSM-backed CMKs. Envelope encryption ensures model-serving hosts never have raw keys. For Dedicated, we can integrate their KMS or use Redwood-managed keys with strict access controls.

ryan-partners: Good. HelioBridge also asked about logs and telemetry retention — they need logs kept for 90 days for the pilot. Is that doable?

mohit-ops: Telemetry retention is configurable per tenant. Default 30d, we can bump to 90d for pilot. Note: storage add-on may apply. I'll include the CLI steps for changing retention.

tara-se: Demo script (10 min): 1) 90s architecture + SSO/keys, 2) tenant create + allowlist (2m), 3) live request + perf (3m), 4) ops failover demo (1m), 5) Q&A and next steps (1m 30s).

infra-bot: Provisioning checklist added: ticket #INC-1740123. Please attach runbook link when ready.

elaine-sales: Any SSO asks? HelioBridge mentioned SCIM + SAML for production. For the pilot they accept basic auth. we should note timeline for SAML onboarding (2-3 weeks).

diana-security: Data residency: we can host tenant in eu-west-1 for EU residency. For the pilot they prefer US, but ask about future EU move. Include migration notes.

mohit-ops: Migration note: snapshot configs + model pinning supported. Migration window ~2 hours for tenant move with DNS update. I'll write steps.

ryan-partners: Who will own the security questionnaire responses? Also need a short one-pager for HelioBridge post-demo with the quote and pilot runbook.

diana-security: I'll own questionnaire answers. will put draft in the drive and mark items that need legal/SOC2 docs under NDA.

tara-se: I'll assemble the demo playbook and example terminal commands and post to the shared doc.

elaine-sales: I'll prep the PO template and include the provisional pricing. target to have everything in the follow-up email within 24 hours of the demo.

mohit-ops: Shared doc link (draft): https://drive.redwood/pilots/heliobridge-playbook-1740123456 — please add comments.

ryan-partners: Great work. Two blockers: (1) confirm static egress IPs for the demo by EOD, (2) finance sign-off on pilot pricing. if either misses, we'll run hosted-only demo.

infra-bot: Reminder created: confirm egress IPs by 18:00 PT.

diana-security: Noted — I'll attach the KMS/HSM language and the retention options in the questionnaire doc.

tara-se: One more quick note: include a short perf table in the runbook showing token cost delta between quantized and full-precision models. HelioBridge asked about token unit economics.

elaine-sales: Thanks team. tagging @ryan-partners to schedule the demo invite after runbook review. :calendar:
